d: A powerful 7.0-magnitude earthquake has struck northern Tibet, killing at least 16 people and injuring 65 as rescue operations gather pace. At least 339 homes and 20 livestock sheds have collapsed or been damaged, as authorities race to assess the damage and search for survivors. Rescue efforts face added challenges in the remote, high-altitude region, with rockfalls cutting off a section of a key national highway and snowfall forecast expected to hamper operations further.
